subject: Mismatch: PO token issued vs. spend cap on Helios onboarding

From: Daniel Park <accounts@helios-devices.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helios-devices.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missing PO token / spend cap on Redwood onboarding

Hi Rishi,

We're almost across the finish line with onboarding but hit a blocker on the PO side. We received a PO token from Redwood (PO-7459) yesterday but the spend cap in our portal still shows $0 and the line items are blank. Our billing team can't process invoices without a valid spend bucket and the line-item mapping.

Quick facts:
- Helios account: Helios Devices Inc.
- Requested total spend cap: $85,000
- Request submitted with onboarding form on 2026-09-09 (I attached the PDF we submitted)
- Token we saw in the email: PO-7459 (no line mapping)

Can you confirm whether this is an alias/temporary token or the final PONUM? If temporary, can you share the follow-up PO number and the spend cap assignment timeline?

I've attached a screenshot of the portal ledger and our onboard form. If easier, loop in procurement and finance and I can hop on a quick call.

Thanks —
Daniel Park
Accounts Payable | Helios Devices Inc.
T: +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: helios_onboard_form_v2.pdf (application/pdf); ledger-snap-20260914.png (image/png)

Forwarding Helios' note — they received PO-7459 but no spend cap or line-item mapping landed in ledger. Monica / Kim: can procurement confirm whether PO-7459 was provisional (stub) or a final issuance? Marcus / Jordan: if provisional, what is the path to (a) assign spend band and (b) map the three invoiceable SKUs to lines? Helios is requesting next steps today so we don't block their billing.

Proposed immediate actions:
- Monica: check onboarding ticket PROC-1214 for Helios and confirm PO type (provisional vs final).
- Kim: if form fields were incomplete, can we accept the attached onboard form as supplemental and push a corrected PO?
- Marcus: estimate how long finance needs to provision the spend cap ($85k) once procurement confirms.
- Jordan: if this needs a temporary reissue (provisional PO -> final PO), advise whether we can issue within 24 hours.

If helpful, I'll set a 15-min sync with Helios at 11:30 PT.

—Rishi

Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the ping, Rishi — copied ticket details below. I pulled PROC-1214 and see the onboarding form attached to the ticket does not include the finalized spend approval field (procurement checkbox). That likely caused the token to be issued as a provisional stub (PO-7459).

Notes from my check:
- PO-7459 status: provisional_stamped (system label). Not final.
- Form issue: the "approved spend bracket" field was left blank in the PDF; procurement's automation defaults to $0 when that field is missing.
- Required for finalization: signed spend approval (procurement) + finance allocation confirmation (ledger bucket).

Action plan:
1) Kimberly — can we accept the attached supplemental form (helios_onboard_form_v2.pdf) as confirmation of the $85,000 bracket and stamp for approval? If so, I'll update PROC-1214 and request PO finalization.
2) Marcus — once procurement marks approved, please create the ledger spend bucket and map the three invoice lines (SKU-HL-01, SKU-HL-02, SKU-HL-03).
3) Rishi — please confirm with Daniel whether they can accept a short addendum email (signed from their procurement contact) rather than a re-uploaded PDF; that'll speed things.

I can file request for final PO once Kimberly confirms acceptance and Marcus confirms allocation ETA. I expect this to be resolvable same day if we get the signed confirmation.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference

Attachments: po_request_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Hi Monica / team — thanks for the quick follow-up. We can confirm the $85,000 band and signed confirmation is in this reply (please consider this email as the procurement signoff). Apologies for the blank field on the upload — our vendor portal stripped a page during PDF export.

For clarity:
- Approved spend cap: $85,000 (Helios Devices Inc.)
- Invoiceable lines: SKU-HL-01 (Device unit fees), SKU-HL-02 (Support retainer), SKU-HL-03 (Data egress credits)
- Preferred PO reference on invoices: final PO number (please notify us of the final PONUM)

I've attached the reseller onboarding form in the thread and a filled PO template (po_request_template.xlsx) — let me know if you need a DocuSign signature.

Best,

Thanks, all. Monica, PDF/email confirmation is sufficient for procurement automation to proceed internally. I've created the ledger spend bucket (code: LEDG-HELIOS-085K) and mapped the three SKUs to the bucket.

Final PO issuance: I updated PROC-1214 and marked PO-7459 as "escalate->finalize" which auto-generated the final PO PO-7459-F (system suffix). That final PO is now visible in the finance portal and tied to LEDG-HELIOS-085K.

Quick checklist completed:
- [x] Procurement sign-off (email from S. Benson)
- [x] Ledger spend bucket created (LEDG-HELIOS-085K)
- [x] SKU line mapping: SKU-HL-01, SKU-HL-02, SKU-HL-03 -> LEDG-HELIOS-085K
- [x] Final PO: PO-7459-F created and assigned

Rishi — please confirm with Daniel that invoices should reference PO-7459-F. Kim / Monica: I'll leave PROC-1214 in "awaiting vendor confirmation" for 48 hours then close.

—Marcus
